_comment: Copy this file to scribe-llm.json (project root) or <data_dir>/scribe-llm.json, then fill in api_key and model. Defaults target 火山方舟 (Doubao); change base_url for other OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, OpenAI, self-hosted vLLM, etc).
_price_comment: Optional. Yuan (¥) per 1 million tokens. Used purely for UI cost estimation; leave at 0 to disable. Reference (per 1M tok): doubao-seed-2.0-lite ≈ 输入 0.30 / 输出 0.60; doubao-pro ≈ 输入 0.80 / 输出 2.00; DeepSeek-V3 ≈ 输入 0.50 / 输出 8.00. Always cross-check with the provider's pricing page before relying on the figure.
